summary: Localized monthly grid for picking a date or a range, with bounds and unavailable dates.
whenToUse: Availability shown inline on the page (bookings, schedules).
Range selection where the month context helps.
whenNotToUse: Compact form field: use DatePicker / DateRangePicker.
Distant dates (e.g. date of birth): typing is faster.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled date or range.

props.name: minValue / maxValue
props.description: Bounds: out-of-range days are disabled and navigation stops.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Non-selectable days (struck through, not just colored).

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: Overrides the first day of the week inferred from the locale.

props.name: visibleMonths
props.description: Months shown side by side (they wrap on narrow screens).

props.name: showMonthYearPicker
props.description: Native month and year selects in place of the heading, to jump quickly to distant dates.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown when isInvalid is set or the selected date is unavailable.

props.name: allowsNonContiguousRanges
props.description: RangeCalendar: allows ranges that include unavailable days.

inherits: Props of the react-aria-components Calendar / RangeCalendar (focusedValue, isReadOnly, isDisabled…).
accessibility: APG “Date picker dialog” pattern for the grid; day headers have full names.
Today, selection, and unavailability are not conveyed by color alone (border, fill, strikethrough).
responsive: Cells have a minimum touch target; multiple months wrap instead of overflowing.
customization: className on the container; colors derive from the color.action.* and color.surface.* roles.
commonMistakes: Converting a CalendarDate to a Date using the local time zone: the day can shift. Use date.toString() (YYYY-MM-DD).
Using new Date() as value: use parseDate or today(getLocalTimeZone()).

examples.name: Controlled
examples.title: Controlled with bounds and unavailable weekends

examples.name: Localized
examples.title: Localization and first day of the week

limits: Examples use the Gregorian calendar only; other systems are supported by @internationalized/date but are not tested.
